# Scope of Cover

Hospitalisation treatment is covered when medically necessary and supported by the required claim documents.

# Waiting Period

A 24 month waiting period applies from policy start for planned treatment, unless continuity credit is recorded.

# Limits and Deductions

The payable amount cannot exceed the available sum insured.

# Exclusions

Cosmetic treatment is excluded unless required following an accidental injury.
